references.text: A voice cries out in the wilderness: Prepare the way for the Lord; make straight paths for him. This verse prophesies about John the Baptist's ministry, as described in Mark 1:5.

Then the people of Israel and Judah will come together; they will weep and seek the Lord their God. This verse can be seen in light of the great multitude who sought out John to be baptized, as mentioned in Mark 1:5.

God, be merciful to me according to your lovingkindness; blot out my transgression in your great compassion. This verse reflects the spirit of repentance and confession expressed by those baptized by John in the Jordan, as described in Mark 1:5.

They will come with weeping, and I will lead them while they pray. I will guide them to streams of water on a straight path where they will not stumble. For I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn. This verse can be associated with the people's actions in Mark 1:5, where they came to John, confessed their sins, and were baptized.
